integrity.statement: Mathematical proof supplied; two methodologically distinct finite computational checks are included as corroboration, not substitutes for the all-size proof.

scientific_limitations: Claim is for the full finite set-partition lattice equipped only with its directed cover relation and two-way counting refinement.
Orbit partition recovery within the given lattice does not imply identification against arbitrary finite structures.
The uniform two-round bound is sharp for every \(n\ge14\), while the small-n one-round threshold is checked by a finite exact enumeration.
Specialized prior coverage cannot be excluded and no independent priority review has been performed.
title: Two-round orbit recovery from cover counts in finite partition lattices
